==Events==
*The [[Gungan–Naboo War]] comes to an end.<ref name="Chrono">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*The hereditary monarchy on Naboo is abolished in favor of an elected one.<ref name="Chrono" />
*[[The Uprisings]] begin on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]].
